summary_requirements: Dedicated VPC deployment for ad personalization and reranking. Strict p95 latency target (~75ms at 128 tokens), throughput baseline 3k req/s with bursts to 6k. Strong cost constraints; want Optimize recommendations (batching, caching, quantization) and clear perf benchmarks comparing model variants and quant profiles.
p0_metrics: throughput_target: 3,000 req/s steady, sustain 6,000 req/s bursts
perf_benchmark_requests: Requested bench plan: run Dedicated cluster experiments across three model/quant profiles (fp16 baseline, int8, int4-ish proxy) using customer sample workload (1M requests, mixed prompt lengths: 8k requests @32 tokens, 750k @64 tokens, 250k @128 tokens). Measure p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, memory pressure, and quality delta (synthetic BLEU/embedding-sim stability). Test batching policies: (1) minimal/no batching, (2) continuous batching with 20ms accumulation window, (3) fixed-window batching (10/50ms) and show tail latency regressions. Run cache hit scenarios: 0%, 30%, 60% prefix cache hit to show latency/cost delta. Deliverables: bench report + raw logs, recommended quantization & batching config for production, cost model (per 100k requests), and a short runbook for fallback routing (model variant and region).
